summary: Customer is unable to check loan balance online.

intents.keywords: I tried checking my loan balance online but it says...account not found help

issues.issue: Account not linked to online portal
issues.reason(s): Account was not initially linked during setup.

intents.actions of agent: Agent confirmed the account number and offered to link the account to the portal and provide login instructions.
intents.resolution: Account linked to portal and login instructions sent.

intents.keywords: I am not good with these online things will it be easy?

issues.issue: Customer is not comfortable with online portals.
issues.reason(s): Customer expresses unfamiliarity with online systems.

intents.actions of agent: Agent assured the customer it is simple, will send a guide, and offered further assistance via call.
intents.resolution: Agent provided reassurance, a guide, and offered further support.
